synth.notes:
Player moves 3px over floor colours {1,4}; next rect overlapping a block = kick (player stays).
Kicked chain slides 1 cell/tick over {1,4,15} with closure, stopped by walls/edge/player/non-fitting socket interior (inset 1).
Click on a block: player takes its rect; old player left as inert husk (e rim, 4 centre).
Render: e rim + centre 5 (blocks)/0 (player), player edges touching a block drawn 0; bg under movers from socket rims or neighbouring terrain.
HUD row 63 zeros = (k+1)//2 actions, k carried on frame continuity (unconfirmed: fitting-socket entry effect).
